evals.name: actions-commitments-eval-1-single-deal-routes-to-get-deal-next-steps
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'what's next on the Acme expansion?'
evals.expected_output: The skill calls get_deal_next_steps rather than ask_zime_brain, since the request names one specific deal.
expectations: get_deal_next_steps is called, not ask_zime_brain, for a single named deal
The committed/scheduled/recommended groupings are kept separate in the answer

evals.name: actions-commitments-eval-2-cross-deal-routes-to-ask-zime
evals.prompt: user asks: 'what are my action items from this week across all my deals?'
evals.expected_output: The skill calls ask_zime_brain rather than get_deal_next_steps, since no single deal is named.
expectations: ask_zime_brain is called for the cross-deal/personal question
get_deal_next_steps is not called when no single deal is named

evals.name: actions-commitments-eval-3-honest-failure
evals.prompt: get_deal_next_steps returns {"error": "INTERNAL_ERROR"} on both the first attempt and the retry
evals.expected_output: After exactly one retry, the skill states plainly the deal-analysis service couldn't be reached and offers the transcript/CRM-export fallback. It does not substitute a from-memory next-step list.
expectations: Exactly one retry before giving up
The failure is stated plainly with the local fallback offered
No next-step list is fabricated from memory
